dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the posterior base to the apex, forming a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute or pointed termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at approximately a 40-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate width-to-height ratio of 1.7:1 based on visible base transition to apex height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous small, circular white punctate markings across the skin surface. A distinct, darker, elongated patch with irregular texture is visible on the lateral flank below the anterior dorsal fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique distribution of white micro-pigmentation spots concentrated along the dorsal ridge anterior to the fin.
